label: The roles an account can have

default.label: Owner
default.doc: Opens everything, the admin screens included; publishes and deletes in the builders.

default.label: Editor
default.doc: Uses the portal's screens; in the builders edits, reviews and publishes chips and rules.

default.label: Author
default.doc: Uses the portal's screens; in the builders drafts and tests their own chips and rules, then submits them.

default.label: Member
default.doc: Uses the portal's screens they are allowed. No builders.

description_nl: Every role, most powerful first, with the words the People screen shows for it.
weight_basis: Platform access primitive, no business content. The knobs ARE the policy — edit them here, never in Python.
